title: FreedomCore Atlas — Security Posture & Audit Evidence Index (v3.2)
claims_boundary: Self-published architectural and cryptographic provenance index. Point-in-time evidence hashes and timestamps are recorded per control; controls that are staged awaiting host installation (such as ATLAS-SEC-11 Market Pulse retirement) are explicitly labeled staged_pending_installation with verified_at=null.

controls.control_title: Public HTTPS Surface & Internal Monitor Port Isolation at Nginx Edge
controls.reproducible_check: Fetch https://atlas.freedomcore.io/security/ over HTTPS: HTTP 200 with Strict-Transport-Security "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload", and the page states that services bind to 127.0.0.1 loopback sockets; the internal monitor route https://atlas.freedomcore.io/api/atlas/daily-notes/monitor returns HTTP 404 at the public edge.
controls.scope_and_limits: Covers public HTTPS origin routing; third-party TLS/header grades must be re-tested directly at external scanner tools.

controls.control_title: Stripe-Hosted Checkout Isolation (Zero Raw Card Collection on Atlas Origin)
controls.reproducible_check: Read https://atlas.freedomcore.io/privacy/ ("Payment details stay with Stripe"; "Stripe operates checkout and stores card details as a PCI DSS Level 1 service provider") and confirm that /privacy/, /security/ and /pricing/ contain no card-number input fields on the Atlas origin.
controls.scope_and_limits: Describes payment card isolation; account entitlement state is verified server-side per session. This re-check covers public pages only; signed-in upgrade flows were not exercised.

controls.control_title: Browser-Local Studio Playlist & Quakes Queue Privacy (No Server Upload of Saved Bookmarks)
controls.reproducible_check: Add an event from /quakes/ (Atlas Quakes) to the Studio playlist; verify state is stored in window.localStorage['atlas.quakes.playlist.v1'] with zero outbound POST/PUT requests.
controls.scope_and_limits: Applies to anonymous and browser-saved research queues on /quakes/ and /studio/.

controls.control_title: Canonical listing_key Disambiguation Across 330 Colliding Bare-Ticker Groups (722 Listings)
controls.reproducible_check: Verify that all 6,394 rows in atlas-symbol-coverage.json carry a unique exchange- or namespace-qualified listing_key (e.g., CRYPTO:SOL vs ASX:SOL vs JSE:SOL vs MIL:SOL vs BME:SOL).
controls.scope_and_limits: Prevents cross-market data corruption caused by bare-ticker joins.

controls.control_title: Explicit 5-State Source Inventory & Fail-Closed record_missing Labeling (Zero Blank States)
controls.reproducible_check: Audit record_state across all 6,394 rows in atlas-symbol-coverage.csv; confirm 3,961 rows have record_exists=true with original record_checked_at and record_sha256, and 2,433 rows are explicitly record_missing.
controls.scope_and_limits: Directory registration (6,394 listings) is explicitly separated from runtime research state (5,142 research reports observed; 1,252 not observed: 1,070 insufficient evidence, 157 blocked, 25 not qualified), as counted in the authority manifest of 2026-11-07.

controls.control_title: Two-Clock Temporal Provenance Separation in Atlas Quakes (Quote Observation Clock vs. Source Event Date)
controls.reproducible_check: Inspect Atlas Quakes (/quakes/); verify quote observation timestamps are never overwritten by or conflated with primary filing/news event dates.
controls.scope_and_limits: Prevents stale or unverified price observations from being presented as live reactions to dated events.

controls.control_title: SHA-256 Receipt-Bound Daily Note & Broadcast Audio Admission Gate
controls.reproducible_check: Verify recent_issues[] in atlas-dispatch-latest.json carry 64-hex source_fingerprint and publication_receipt_sha256 digests, while 8 unverified editions remain explicitly under_review.
controls.scope_and_limits: Ensures only receipt-bound editions expose playable broadcast audio on /studio/.

controls.control_title: 5-Palette 4K Broadcast Derivative & Master FLAC Audio Hash Binding on Atlas Studio
controls.reproducible_check: Inspect atlas-broadcast-manifest.json and /studio/ player gates; confirm all 5 theme palettes (obsidian, daylight, emerald, cobalt, ivory) bind to verified 3840x2160 MP4/WebP derivatives and master FLAC/MP3 digests.
controls.scope_and_limits: Programmes under review remain non-playable until derivative and receipt gates pass.

controls.control_title: Fail-Closed Held Profile & Unverified Quote Suppression on Public Company/Crypto Pages
controls.reproducible_check: Inspect held or dated-quote profiles (such as /stocks/asx-sol/, /stocks/vie-ebs/, /stocks/egx-comi/) to confirm dated quotes display their exact observation timestamp and held profiles never fabricate live prices or supply ratios.
controls.scope_and_limits: Applies across all 6,375 company and crypto profile pages and Realm directory cards.

controls.control_title: Atlas Quakes Canonical Feed Generation & /quakes/ Route Compatibility
controls.reproducible_check: Verify /quakes/ serves 'Atlas Quakes · Source-dated market developments' (HTML SHA-256 721e95bdab7c1a2486194a2e71815d892c65814ed85af457050f4aec7a6d8434) generated by atlas_quakes_feed.py (SHA-256 89abbc8bd85abeb7ad864d4c35ddfa7966ae2f9cd94f5a471fc0708d86c530a1) while preserving internal feed compatibility aliases.
controls.scope_and_limits: Preserves live Studio playlist and daily despatch compatibility.

controls.control_title: Legacy Market Pulse Dataset Retirement & Historical Archive Preservation (2026-08-17 Baseline)
controls.reproducible_check: Live preimage at /datasets/atlas-market-pulse/ is 3a00e5e4ef5b984e53788389f15471fe4f4b4f59897c0b7446bd07d78698bd04 and live /datasets/ catalog is 447c6005b75eba20bb55edad0e00d34997579a138d457c1367b4c8f9a8947c7d. Staged retirement candidates (datasets/index.html sha256=2caabe26730e49ad2942ecfb24d6675b8dd31b869964e89e05c9b6d8da9f09d7, datasets/atlas-market-pulse/index.html sha256=7a15c37049626cde6b6b9737dd8d1fdd1c5fe914f86d86dd0aac1d538f223c4b) and Kaggle/Hugging Face retirement metadata are authorized by owner directive c273fd185d09a610cb8154876ade5184a56a9ff501f949fba29504028659fd26 (2026-10-25T18:10:03Z) and awaiting host installation/publication.
controls.scope_and_limits: Distinguishes owner authorization and staged candidates from completed public installation; preserves 2026-08-17 Version 68 files on Kaggle and commit cb33cf75... on Hugging Face untouched.

controls.control_title: Explicit Self-Published Security Claims Boundary & External Re-Verification Rule
controls.reproducible_check: Confirm that https://atlas.freedomcore.io/security/ keeps its own architectural statements separate from live third-party checks: its "Independent external verifiers" section links Qualys SSL Labs, Mozilla Observatory and SecurityHeaders so grades can be re-tested at the source.
controls.scope_and_limits: External reviewers should always run live checks against https://atlas.freedomcore.io/security/.

freshness_note: v3.2 (2026-11-07): ATLAS-SEC-01, ATLAS-SEC-02, ATLAS-SEC-04, ATLAS-SEC-05, ATLAS-SEC-12 were re-checked at 2026-11-07T00:14:37Z against canonical pages (/security/, /privacy/) and the register files pinned by the authority manifest of 2026-11-07; verified_at is re-dated only where the check passed.
